project_type: pnpm monorepo: React 19 + Vite SPA (apps/web) and Express 5 + Prisma 7 API (apps/api)
language: TypeScript (ESM, NodeNext). API tsconfig is strict with noUncheckedIndexedAccess + exactOptionalPropertyTypes + verbatimModuleSyntax; use .js extensions on relative imports.
build_system: pnpm workspaces. API builds with tsc (plain). Web builds with 'tsc -b && vite build'. Root scripts: typecheck = api tsc --noEmit then web tsc --noEmit.
test_framework: No unit test framework is configured (apps/api test script is a placeholder 'exit 1'; apps/web has eslint only). Verification is the TypeScript typecheck/build plus manual code-trace of the save/load round trip and auth token delivery.

key_patterns: env values are centralized in apps/api/src/config/env.ts (env.SESSION_COOKIE_NAME default 'qivo_session'; env.SESSION_DAYS parsed as Number default 30). Auth uses a localStorage Bearer token (apps/web/src/lib/api.ts never sets credentials:'include'); login/signup/google all return { token, user, workspace } in the response body. Scheduled publish runs via publishDueForms() on a 60s setInterval in server.ts (runPublishSweep). getFormSchema(f.schema).settings holds scheduledPublishAt/scheduledCloseAt. FormStatus enum includes CLOSED; closeForm() already sets status:'CLOSED'. The QuestionType union is defined (not yet exported) in form.service.ts and mirrored by questionTypeSchema (z.enum) in form.schemas.ts.
